title: Electrical Appliances for Domestic Use (Quality Control) Order, 2023
product: Electric Kettles, Water Heaters, Liquid Heating Appliances
exemption_policy: Goods manufactured for export only are exempt. Small enterprises given phased transition.
penalty_clause: Section 29 of BIS Act, 2016 (Fine up to ₹5 lakh or imprisonment up to 2 years for non-compliance)

title: Food Safety and Standards (Prohibition and Restrictions on Sales) Regulations - Packaged Water
ministry: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare / Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
product: Packaged Drinking Water & Packaged Natural Mineral Water
exemption_policy: No domestic sale or distribution permitted without active BIS ISI Mark Licence and FSSAI clearance.
penalty_clause: Seizure of goods and prosecution under BIS Act 2016 & Food Safety Act 2006

title: Toys (Quality Control) Order, 2020
product: Electric and Non-Electric Toys for Children Under 14 Years
exemption_policy: Artisan/traditional handmade wooden toys crafted by registered artisans exempted from factory audit fees under DPIIT incentive scheme.
penalty_clause: Confiscation of non-compliant inventory and penal action under BIS Act, 2016

title: Domestic Pressure Cooker (Quality Control) Order, 2020
product: Domestic Pressure Cookers (Aluminium and Stainless Steel)
exemption_policy: Units manufacturing purely for export with customs bonded verification exempted.
penalty_clause: CCPA and BIS joint enforcement against e-commerce sellers distributing uncertified cookers

title: Helmet for Two Wheeler Riders (Quality Control) Order, 2020
ministry: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)
exemption_policy: Imported or domestic helmets must conform to IS 4151 weight <= 1.2 kg and bear ISI mark.
penalty_clause: Motor Vehicles Act 2019 & BIS Act 2016 enforcement

title: Footwear Made from Leather and Other Materials (Quality Control) Order, 2024
product: Sports Footwear, Casual Shoes, Safety Footwear
exemption_policy: Micro and Small enterprises granted extended transition up to early 2025; currently mandatory for medium and large manufacturers.
penalty_clause: Prohibition of sale on e-commerce and retail counters under Section 17 of BIS Act 2016

qco_number: S.O. 1827(E) / Steel and Steel Products QCO 2020
title: Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order, 2020
product: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars (TMT Rebars)
exemption_policy: Strict zero-tolerance on uncertified rebars; compulsory certification for all rolling mills.
penalty_clause: Immediate sealing of rolling mills and criminal confiscation of non-ISI reinforcement bars

title: Cement (Quality Control) Order, 2023
exemption_policy: All domestic and imported cement must bear ISI mark.
penalty_clause: Strict seizure under Section 29, BIS Act, 2016

title: Hallmarking of Gold Jewellery and Gold Artefacts Order, 2020
status: In Force (Notified in 350+ Districts across India)
exemption_policy: Jewellers with annual turnover below ₹40 lakh exempt; articles weighing under 2 grams exempt; export jewellery exempt.
penalty_clause: Fine of minimum ₹1 lakh or 5 times the market value of the jewellery piece, and up to 1 year imprisonment
